appearance.subtle: Their outline seems indistinct at the edges.
appearance.obvious: Their flesh sags and firms as they move, and their fingers are longer than they were a minute ago.
appearance.extreme: They are barely holding a human shape. Their edges blur, their limbs elongate as they reach, and part of their shoulder is currently inside the doorframe.

description: Your density is no longer fixed. You can go soft enough to pour yourself through a gap that should not admit you, and it is as unpleasant as it sounds.
name: Phase Flesh
